role: Declares nbt_set_key, the replace-or-add of one key in a compound done through the canonical text form (nbtedit.c), and explains why nbtjson's append-only nbt_put was not enough.
notes: nbtjson.h now also has nbt_replace and nbt_comp_set, which replace a key in place; nbt_set_key predates or duplicates them (not verified which).
